description: Street Network of Bogota, Colombia, 2021 is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Alex Quistberg, Olga Lucia Sarmiento (Drexel University). This dataset is part of the ESCALA (Study of Urban Health and Climate Change in Informal Settlements in Latin America) project that was funded by the Lacuna Fund of the Meridian Institute https://lacunafund.org/. This dataset contains the street network and intersections of Bogota, Colombia as of 2021. Coverage: national (CO); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. Formats: PDF. Size stated: 145. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
